description: Unit test class 'DeleteConnectionTest' for testing the 'DeleteConnection' class which handles delete connection commands within a connectivity module, verifying behaviors such as JSON serialization, equality, immutability, and resource path retrieval.

classes.name: DeleteConnectionTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for verifying the behavior of the DeleteConnection class.

methods.name: testHashCodeAndEquals
methods.description: Verifies that the equals and hashCode methods of DeleteConnection conform to their contracts using EqualsVerifier.

methods.name: assertImmutability
methods.description: Checks that instances of DeleteConnection are immutable, considering also the mutability of ConnectionId.

methods.name: createInstanceWithNullConnectionId
methods.description: Ensures that creating a DeleteConnection with a null ConnectionId throws a NullPointerException with an appropriate message.

methods.name: fromJsonReturnsExpected
methods.description: Tests that the fromJson method correctly deserializes a JSON object into a DeleteConnection instance matching expectations.

methods.name: toJsonReturnsExpected
methods.description: Verifies that the toJson method correctly serializes a DeleteConnection instance into the expected JSON object.

methods.name: getResourcePathReturnsExpected
methods.description: Checks that the getResourcePath method returns the correct JSONPointer resource path, which is the root in this case.
